# Places

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Every ward, ED and community team in the network. The band names the wards whose bed count needs a check.

## What is on the screen

1. What needs a check. The band names the wards whose bed count is old, with the ward to ask first.
2. Places and Catchments. Catchments finds which community team covers a suburb.
3. Search places. Type a ward, hospital, ED, team or service. Show narrows the list to wards, EDs or teams.
4. The network. Every place, grouped by service. Choose one to see who is heading or waiting there, then refer or open it.
5. At a glance. Wards that need a bed check, wards by service, and the places you pinned or opened lately.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
